adapterResponsibilities: Pass stable read-only TanStack effective-state sources through context, not a second writable theme snapshot.
Set subscribe:true to support provider replacement and late-provider reparents.
Create/attach the late-provider root per actual ownerDocument and detach its listeners when its owner ends.
On connection/rebinding reset the old model parent then issue discovery, batched to avoid intermediate published configuration.
Observe relevant slot assignment changes and invoke public rediscovery; stock context does not do this. Closed-root automated invalidation still needs its own proof.
Adoption also rebinds the document system-appearance source and document resource ownership; context alone only discovers the destination provider.
Overlay lifetime owns a live opener-source request, disposal and rediscovery when the native opener moves; explicit ContextEvent rebinding passed, automatic opener-move observation is unproven.
Provider/root library listeners and root lifetime need deliberate ownership; do not assume a general ContextProvider disposal API exists.
limits: 13 bounded checks per engine: 11 pass and two intentional stock failures, followed by passing explicit repair checks. Not whole component acceptance.
The refresh fixture explicitly calls public hostDisconnected/hostConnected and resets its source holder in TanStack batch. It does not demonstrate automatic slot invalidation.
Closed-root initial discovery passed; closed-root slot reassignment, manual slot.assign and fallback/forwarded slot changes are not tested.
Cross-document adoption into an already-present destination provider passed; a late provider in a new document still requires that document ContextRoot setup.
Native opener current-state following and explicit rebind/disposal passed; full overlay lifecycle/native top-layer/custom token propagation are untested here.
No final acme-theme DOM/CSS, locale/direction resolution, theme registration or custom token schema implemented.
An initial scratch build imported internal ContextRequestEvent; corrected to the actual public ContextEvent export before browser tests.
